chill.name: Light (Low Event/Antag Rolls)
chill.desc: This storyteller will be light on events and antag rolls compared to other storytellers, especially so on ones involving combat, destruction, or chaos. The least hectic storyteller of all, while still having some spice. Best for RP-focused rounds with a few events and antags sprinkled in.
chill.welcome_text: If you vote for this storyteller on Ice Box, you have no originality.
